definitions: A logical arrangement of tables in a multidimensional database such that the entity relationship diagram resembles a snowflake shape. It is a variation of the star schema.
A dimensional model where dimension tables are normalized into multiple related tables, creating a more complex structure than a star schema.
examples: The data warehouse uses a Snowflake schema for its analytical reporting.
Designing a Snowflake schema can reduce data redundancy but may increase query complexity.
Many business intelligence tools support querying data organized in a Snowflake schema.
